steps.name: seed-mep-circuits-aircon
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.suggestMepPoints?.(); s.suggestSwitchCircuits?.(); s.planAircon?.(); })()

steps.name: intercept-window-open
steps.eval: window.open = () => ({ document: { write(h) { window.__lastHtml = h }, close() {} }, close() {}, focus() {}, print() {} })

steps.name: build-packs-via-open-flow
steps.eval: (async () => { const { openTradePack } = await import('/src/ui/openTradePack.ts'); window.__packs = {}; for (const id of ['tiler','electrician','aircon','painter']) { window.__lastHtml = null; await openTradePack(id); window.__packs[id] = window.__lastHtml; } })()

waitFor.store: window.__packs && typeof window.__packs.tiler === 'string' && window.__packs.tiler.length > 1000 && typeof window.__packs.aircon === 'string'

steps.name: assert-pack-content
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__packs; const need = (html, re, label) => { if (!re.test(html)) throw new Error('missing in ' + label + ': ' + re); }; need(p.tiler, /Tiler & wet works/, 'tiler recipient'); need(p.tiler, /Finishes schedule/, 'tiler finishes'); need(p.tiler, /Wet-area notes/, 'tiler wet notes'); if (/FF&E schedule/.test(p.tiler)) throw new Error('tiler must NOT contain FF&E'); need(p.tiler, /Sheet numbers below are the MASTER/, 'numbering note'); need(p.electrician, /Electrician/, 'electrician recipient'); need(p.electrician, /Electrical plan/, 'electrician sheet'); need(p.electrician, /Mount-height conventions/, 'mount heights'); need(p.electrician, /SP Group/, 'DB note'); need(p.aircon, /Proposed multi-split systems/, 'aircon systems'); need(p.aircon, /System-\d|Single split/, 'aircon system label'); need(p.painter, /Paint-area quantity basis/, 'painter basis'); window.__assertOk = true; })()

steps.name: scroll-to-electrical-sheet
steps.eval: (() => { const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tb-name')]; const el = names.find((n) => n.textContent.trim().startsWith('Electrical plan')); const sheet = el && el.closest('.sheet'); if (!sheet) throw new Error('electrical sheet not found'); sheet.scrollIntoView(); })()

steps.name: scroll-to-tiler-finishes
steps.eval: (() => { const names = [...document.querySelectorAll('.tb-name')]; const el = names.find((n) => n.textContent.trim().startsWith('Finishes schedule')); const sheet = el && el.closest('.sheet'); if (!sheet) throw new Error('finishes sheet not found'); sheet.scrollIntoView(); })()
